caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a metal pin or brooch. It consists of a straight vertical shaft that is dark gray to black in color, tapering slightly towards the rounded bottom end. Attached to the top of the shaft is a horizontal bar, also dark in color, which extends to the right and curls upward at its tip. The left end of the bar is shaped into a tight spiral or coil, consisting of two clear loops. The overall composition is centered on a plain, off-white background, and the object is rendered with shading to suggest a metallic surface and three-dimensional form.
title: Shutter Fastener
